text: Do the lesions have a silvery scale, and have you noticed any involvement of your nails or joints? I would also like to examine the rash directly to assess its morphology.

speaker: Doctor
text: I am examining the rash now and observe flat-topped, polygonal, violaceous papules with fine white lines (Wickham striae) on the flexor surfaces of your wrists and forearms. Are these lesions particularly itchy at night, and have you noticed any white patches inside your mouth?

text: Denies recent fever, joint pains, weight loss, or changes in bowel habits. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: The clinical presentation of pruritic, flat-topped, violaceous papules with Wickham striae is classic for lichen planus. DIAGNOSIS READY: Lichen Planus
